name: UPSC GS Paper I — PYQ-derived (2015-2026, recency-weighted, 2015 answers unverified)
scope: UPSC GS Paper I only. Additive to BPSC config; does not modify it.
unverified_year_note: 2015 (100 Qs) has no official UPSC answer key found on upsc.gov.in — tagged for subject/topic only, correct_option is blank, excluded from any scoring-accuracy claim but INCLUDED in subject-weight computation (subject tagging doesn't depend on the key).
sub_topic_weights_original_decoder_label: The sub_topic_weights block above uses decoder/PYQ-analysis-era labels that do not match the live admin taxonomy (src/screens/AdminApp.jsx SUBTOPICS_BY_SUBJECT.upsc) 1:1 -- e.g. Geography's combined 'Physical/Human' vs the taxonomy's separate 'Physical'/'Human'; History's single 'Art & Culture' vs the taxonomy's 4-way split. Kept here verbatim for provenance/audit trail. The database's distribution_config.sub_topic_weights row (and sub_topic_weights_reconciled below) is what generate.js actually reads -- it has been UPDATED to the reconciled version, not this block.

sub_topic_weights_reconciled._method: Every decoder-era label was mapped to its nearest admin-taxonomy label; where the taxonomy is MORE granular than the decoder data (e.g. History's Art & Culture -> 4 sub-labels, S&T/Economy's new PYQ-named sub-topics), the parent bucket's weight was carved down using named Q# evidence from the playbook (never fabricated). Where the taxonomy added a label with ZERO PYQ evidence anywhere in the 4-year corpus (Statutory-Laws, Panchayati Raj & Local Governance, Physics), a small deliberate floor (0.018-0.02) was assigned and is flagged '_floor_not_pyq_evidenced' below rather than presented as a real PYQ percentage. Every subject's key set was verified to exactly match SUBTOPICS_BY_SUBJECT.upsc before being pushed to distribution_config.

History._note: Art & Culture (0.0988 orig) split by the only granular evidence available: playbook L.2 cites 5 named 2026 examples -- 2 music (Q1, Q19), 1 architecture (Q4), 1 painting (Q6), 1 iconography (Q12), 0 named for a residual 'other' bucket. Split proportionally 2:1:1:1 off 0.0888, with Culture-Other given a 0.01 floor (_floor_not_pyq_evidenced) since no example was found for it.

Polity._method: Content re-tag of all 148 Polity PYQs 2015-2026 from their actual stems (scratch/retag_polity_subtopics.py -> scratch/polity_subtopic_retag.csv), weighted with the same linear 1..10 recency weights as subject_weights. The decoder had labelled 135/148 'Governance'; 'Governance' now means non-constitutional administration only.

Geography._note: Decoder's 'Physical/Human' (0.8901) is a combined bucket with no finer breakdown anywhere in the playbook. Split 50/50 (_estimate_not_pyq_evidenced, no basis found to weight one side over the other) after folding decoder's separate 'Physical' (0.033) and 'Climatology' (0.022, a physical-geography topic) entirely into Physical.

Economy._note: Agriculture (0.1818) mapped to Five-Year Plans & Policy (closest fit -- MSP/PM-KISAN/land-reform content is policy-heavy). Fiscal Policy/Demography/Corporate Regulation/Taxation/Public Finance/Economic Geography (no dedicated taxonomy bucket for any) folded into Macroeconomics. Fintech-Digital-Finance carved from Macroeconomics using 5 named 2026 examples (Q86 blockchain, Q89 ONDC, Q91 RWA, Q93 M1xchange, Q97 crowdfunding) / 65-Q corpus = ~0.0769. Critical-Minerals-Energy-Transition = decoder's Mining+Energy (0.0114) plus a further Macro carve using 2 named examples (2025-Q6 MSP for minerals, 2026-Q95 REE) / 65 = ~0.0308, totaling 0.0422.

Environment & Ecology._note: Clean reconciliation, no estimation needed -- decoder's 'Ecology/Biodiversity' + 'Biodiversity' were the same concept under two labels (merged); 'Pollution' folded into 'Climate & Pollution'. Matches L.2's 'keep as-is' instruction exactly.

Science & Technology._note: Decoder's 'Energy Tech'/'Earth Science'/'Materials Science' (no dedicated taxonomy buckets) folded into Tech & Innovation. Space-Missions and Defence-Technology each carved from Tech & Innovation using 2 named examples apiece (Space: 2025-Q83 Axiom-4/SpaDeX/Gaganyaan, 2026-Q46 private space; Defence: 2026-Q43 stealth, Q47 drone swarms) / 49-Q corpus = ~0.0408 each. Physics has ZERO named PYQ examples in the 4-year corpus -- 0.02 floor (_floor_not_pyq_evidenced).

Current Affairs._note: Only 'General' (0.0838, an ambiguous decoder catch-all with no taxonomy equivalent) needed redistribution -- spread proportionally across the other 6 categories (_estimate, proportional redistribution, not itself new evidence) rather than assigned to one arbitrarily. Defence and Awards & Appointments already had real decoder-era weights (0.0659, 0.012) before this reconciliation -- L.2's 'add as first-class sub-topic' was about the admin taxonomy not yet having these as pickable entries, not about missing PYQ evidence.

Polity_superseded_decoder_mapping._note: Governance (0.9122) + Governance/Ethics (0.0203, folded in, no separate taxonomy bucket) = 0.9325 combined mass. Judicial-Verdicts carved out using playbook's 2 named examples (2024-Q76 Puttaswamy/privacy, 2024-Q83 Writ of Prohibition) / 56-Q 4-year Polity corpus = ~0.0357. Statutory-Laws and Panchayati Raj & Local Governance have ZERO named PYQ examples anywhere in the playbook -- both are 0.018 floors (_floor_not_pyq_evidenced), not PYQ-derived.

Polity._method: 2023-2026 pooled (n=56: 3 easy / 34 medium / 19 hard), the playbook's own evidence window. The playbook's '42-53% hard' quotes only 2023 and 2026; 2024 was 12% and 2025 31%. Recency 1..10 over 2015-26 would give 13/58/29.
Polity._note: The live distribution_config keeps the global flat mix (easy 0.2636/medium 0.5257/hard 0.2107) as the default for every subject without an override.
